audio.mastering: 48ms silent-head priming correction, 70 Hz high-pass, zero-makeup limiter, two-pass loudnorm I=-16/TP=-2.0/LRA=11; H.264 stream copied without re-encoding

synchronization.caption_motion: Whole-clause opacity fades only; no moving underline, timer, or word-pop animation
synchronization.timing_source: faster-whisper medium.en word timestamps on exact selected-voice master; complete normalized script/token match
synchronization.measurement: Best normalized cross-correlation over 1–12s at 4kHz; positive offset means delivered narration is late
synchronization.delivered_sync_check: passed; absolute narration offset <=12ms and normalized mix correlation >=0.30

pacing.style: Demonstration-led scenes, calm holds, complete-clause captions, restrained cues, ducked instrumental bed, and a proper outro

narration.voice_selection: User-selected narration voice; one continuous take; no alternate voice used
narration.tempo_algorithm: FFmpeg atempo WSOLA; pitch preserved; never faster than source
narration.alignment: faster-whisper medium.en word timestamps on exact paced narration master
narration.asr_tail_filter: Excluded 0 ASR tokens beginning in digital silence at or after 46.985375s
narration.asr_spurious_token_filter: Excluded 0 ASR tokens lasting <=0.10s with probability <0.20; exact full-script match still required
narration.asr_boundary_repeat_filter: Excluded 0 immediately repeated <=0.16s lower-confidence boundary fragments followed by >=0.25s pauses; exact full-script match still required

visual_review.required: Review every narration-clause onset and midpoint plus the outro in ordered sheets; confirm the visible action and focal component match the narration, unrelated elements recede, labels are legible and safe, and no caption progress line appears
visual_review.review_method: Every narration-clause onset and midpoint plus the outro, reviewed in chronological contact sheets decoded from the delivered MP4; one critical detailed cutaway per video also checked at 540x960
checkpoints: Outgoing radio pulses and returning aircraft echoes are visually distinct
The pulse/echo timeline and half-round-trip range formula agree with the narration
The rotating scope sweep accumulates echo blips across directions
No corner topic/duration labels or caption timing/progress line appears
